description: This file defines a custom authentication state provider for a Blazor application, which manages user authentication state by fetching user data from a web API and caching it.

classes.name: CustomAuthStateProvider
classes.description: A custom implementation of AuthenticationStateProvider that fetches user info from a web API, caches the result, and manages authentication state within a Blazor application.

methods.name: GetAuthenticationStateAsync
methods.description: Overrides the base method to return the current authentication state, utilizing caching to reduce API calls.

methods.name: GetUser
methods.description: Private method that retrieves the user info either from cache or by fetching fresh data from the API.

methods.name: FetchUser
methods.description: Private method that calls the web API to get user info and constructs the ClaimsPrincipal representing the authenticated user.
